title: Tea Leafs Revenue Report
description: 3-month revenue overview for Tea Leafs — total revenue, order count, AOV, daily trends, weekly revenue, and checkout flow breakdown.

panels.title: Total Revenue
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TOTAL), 2) FROM TEA_LEAFS_WEB.ORDER_COMPLETED WHERE TIMESTAMP >= {{time_range_start}} AND TIMESTAMP <= {{time_range_end}}

panels.title: Total Orders
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TEA_LEAFS_WEB.ORDER_COMPLETED WHERE TIMESTAMP >= {{time_range_start}} AND TIMESTAMP <= {{time_range_end}}

panels.title: Average Order Value
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(TOTAL), 2) FROM TEA_LEAFS_WEB.ORDER_COMPLETED WHERE TIMESTAMP >= {{time_range_start}} AND TIMESTAMP <= {{time_range_end}}

panels.title: Daily Revenue Trend
panels.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS Day, ROUND(SUM(TOTAL), 2) AS Revenue FROM TEA_LEAFS_WEB.ORDER_COMPLETED WHERE TIMESTAMP >= {{time_range_start}} AND TIMESTAMP <= {{time_range_end}} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekly Revenue
panels.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS Week, ROUND(SUM(TOTAL), 2) AS Revenue FROM TEA_LEAFS_WEB.ORDER_COMPLETED WHERE TIMESTAMP >= {{time_range_start}} AND TIMESTAMP <= {{time_range_end}} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Revenue by Checkout Flow
panels.sql: SELECT COALESCE(CHECKOUT_FLOW, 'standard') AS Flow, ROUND(SUM(TOTAL), 2) AS Revenue FROM TEA_LEAFS_WEB.ORDER_COMPLETED WHERE TIMESTAMP >= {{time_range_start}} AND TIMESTAMP <= {{time_range_end}} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Orders by Checkout Flow
panels.sql: SELECT COALESCE(CHECKOUT_FLOW, 'standard') AS Flow, COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM TEA_LEAFS_WEB.ORDER_COMPLETED WHERE TIMESTAMP >= {{time_range_start}} AND TIMESTAMP <= {{time_range_end}} GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Daily Breakdown
panels.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS Date, COUNT(*) AS Orders, ROUND(SUM(TOTAL), 2) AS "Total Revenue", ROUND(AVG(TOTAL), 2) AS "Avg Order Value", ROUND(SUM(DISCOUNT), 2) AS "Total Discounts", ROUND(SUM(SHIPPING), 2) AS "Total Shipping" FROM TEA_LEAFS_WEB.ORDER_COMPLETED WHERE TIMESTAMP >= {{time_range_start}} AND TIMESTAMP <= {{time_range_end}} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC
